blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A businessman whose company allegedly owes the Land Bank of the Philippines some ₱141.30 million will face graft charges along with three former executives of the bank over loan irregularities. In a statement, the Office of the Ombudsman said it ordered the filing of charges against the former LandBank first vice president Lolita Silva, former assistant vice president Danilo Dayanghirang, former account officer Ronaldo Robles, as well as Alberto Ching, president and chairman of American Boulevard Trading Corp. (ABTC). The charges resulted from a complaint LandBank had filed through its loan recovery department. MORE NATIONAL NEWS: Sara Duterte appears at […]...
